answer: Zero-knowledge proof-of-personhood deters Sybil attacks among agents mapping a smoke plume near a willow grove by requiring each bot to submit a zk-SNARK over an issuer-signed credential in a local vault. Because the proof emits a deterministic epoch nullifier from the hidden identity secret, the registry admits only one active agent per verified human privately. Attackers must recruit distinct real people per alias, though paid credential-rental markets can still supply valid nullifiers.
